mutation_and_red_evidence.regression: mutable timeline subject and raw-event ownership

items.problem: Overview/calendar/requests/report timezone mismatch
items.current_finding: Effective rule timezone drives overview, calendar and request context; reports use persisted record/event timezone with an explicit unavailable state.
items.remaining_scope: Original environment timezone display and deployment identity need a new acceptance run.

items.problem: Taipei morning in and evening out split across work dates
items.current_finding: Synthetic real-database tests preserve early-in/evening-out on one Shanghai or Taipei workday and preserve the published overnight starting workday with original event instants.
items.remaining_scope: The original reported employee/day has not been queried or repaired; explicit client timezone precedence is not changed.

items.problem: Later check-in joins an existing checkout and yields out-before-in
items.current_finding: The final legacy live projection, including optional merge output, rejects out-before-in with ATTENDANCE_PUNCH_ORDER_CONFLICT (409) inside the transaction; both raw event and projection roll back.
items.remaining_scope: Existing reversed records are not repaired. This does not replace or broaden authoritative-engine contracts.

items.problem: Paired short punches have zero work minutes
items.current_finding: Short intervals may legitimately round down to zero. The new order guard prevents new reversed pairs in the covered legacy live path; valid long-pair tests remain positive.
items.remaining_scope: Confirm the original rule, rounding and persisted pair before classifying every zero-minute record as a defect.

items.problem: Extreme late and early minute values
items.current_finding: Late/early values follow the configured work window; an all-day window can explain large values.
items.remaining_scope: Validate the intended policy and original record. No blanket metric rewrite is claimed.

items.problem: Historical timestamp drift or persisted punch polarity changes
items.current_finding: A scoped read-only observation tool compares persisted records and raw events. PostgreSQL retains timestamp microseconds for boundary and reversed-pair comparisons; successful output contains only codes and counts.
items.remaining_scope: No original historical data was read, rewritten or backfilled. Drift and ownership still require an approved, bounded data investigation.

items.problem: Successful morning check-in missing from reports
items.current_finding: The read-only observation tool counts missing boundaries and missing raw-event linkage without synthesizing events.
items.remaining_scope: The original missing event or record has not been restored or proven present.

items.problem: Completed checkout displayed as In / still clocked in
items.current_finding: In/out remain distinct and a completed current-day pair displays clocked out. Today UI now uses the date/session-bound self record with an unknown state until the read succeeds.
items.remaining_scope: Recheck the original deployed build; persisted historical polarity is outside this repair.

items.problem: No today record but historical record drives today clock state and CTA
items.current_finding: History cannot substitute for today. Reuse requires a verified self/session/date-complete history page; otherwise a separate self-today read leaves history filters unchanged. Midnight and session changes invalidate stale results; failures and invalid rule timezones do not imply unpunched.
items.remaining_scope: Original-environment deployment and user acceptance remain pending.

items.problem: Working state lasts 15-30 seconds and reports take several seconds
items.current_finding: Existing punch-button release and post-response refresh behavior remain covered by mounted regression tests.
items.remaining_scope: No original-environment latency measurements, load test or performance service-level acceptance was performed.

items.problem: rules/me rejects override headers
items.current_finding: The rules/me call omits the complete forbidden override-header set and its source-synchronized contract is in the focused passing suite.
items.remaining_scope: Original deployment and real-session rules availability still need verification.

items.problem: No selectable active leave type
items.current_finding: The shipped synthetic fixture SQL is exercised twice idempotently in a disposable database. One active leave type is selectable; a leave request is persisted, checked and cancelled under strict RBAC.
items.remaining_scope: No original QA fixture was seeded and no original account submitted a leave request in this run. Business policy and balance approval remain separate.

items.problem: No selectable active overtime rule
items.current_finding: The local rehearsal verifies one active overtime rule and persists, checks and cancels an overtime request under strict RBAC.
items.remaining_scope: Original QA configuration, deployment and overtime acceptance remain pending.

items.problem: No usable published single-day assignments
items.current_finding: Two published manual single-day assignments are seeded idempotently; the local self-service swap request is persisted, checked and cancelled. Generated/range assignments remain intentionally excluded.
items.remaining_scope: Original QA configuration and a real participant swap acceptance are unverified.

items.problem: Derived row exists but detail says No raw punch events
items.current_finding: Timeline tests use the actual reports route. Empty raw history, unavailable endpoint and missing timezone remain explicit. One-shot report-to-request prefill preserves exact source instants; edited times use the historical timezone, reject gaps and disclose repeated-time policy. Loaded query scope and event user identity prevent cross-user/org relabeling; stale responses are discarded.
items.remaining_scope: No absent historical raw events are reconstructed. Real historic linkage and original-environment endpoint availability remain unverified.

items.problem: Field config Degraded
items.current_finding: The existing UI distinguishes metadata backing degradation and built-in fallback fields.
items.remaining_scope: Original metadata backing availability and repair were not established by this local task.

items.problem: Truncated top-nav identity and wrong shared-browser account
items.current_finding: Account identity display logic retains distinguishing suffixes and full-value tooltip; focused identity tests pass.
items.remaining_scope: Shared-browser identity behavior and original multi-device visual acceptance were not exercised.

items.problem: Annual leave and compensatory balances zero
items.current_finding: Zero balances can be valid without grants. The fixture rehearsal does not grant or alter leave balances.
items.remaining_scope: Validate entitlement/grant policy and the original account before assigning a balance defect.

items.problem: 22 session records including 11 active and 11 revoked
items.current_finding: The existing active-session filter means not revoked; it does not assert concurrently online devices.
items.remaining_scope: No original shared-session or device-state acceptance was conducted.

items.problem: /attendance/records blank legacy route
items.current_finding: The legacy records route redirect is covered by the focused passing suite.
items.remaining_scope: The original deployed route still needs a build-identified acceptance run.
